overview.name: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET)
overview.description: A thermoplastic polymer resin used for manufacturing bottles, fibers, films, and other packaging materials.
overview.overviewDescription: Polyethylene Terephthalate stands as one of the most versatile and widely used polymers globally, serving as the foundation for countless products that define modern life. From the ubiquitous plastic bottles that contain our beverages to the fibers in our clothing and the films that protect our food, PET's unique combination of clarity, strength, barrier properties, and recyclability makes it indispensable across multiple industries. Its role in enabling sustainable packaging solutions and circular economy initiatives positions it as crucial for environmental sustainability.
keyFeatures: Superior barrier properties for gases and moisture
overview.industrialSignificance: PET is one of the most important polymers globally, with annual production exceeding 80 million tons. Its versatility, performance characteristics, and recyclability make it essential for modern packaging, textile, and engineering applications, driving innovation in sustainable materials development.

physicalChemicalProperties.appearance: Clear to opaque, depending on crystallinity
